_inputs: Animated clip FBX live at assets/raw/thug/ (gitignored). Each is one rigged+skinned mesh; the renderer normalises them to a SHARED scale so they line up. Meshy-native exports use arbitrary filenames AND can carry root translation (no 'In Place' option) — that's fine: (1) inPlace:true strips locomotion TRAVEL on import (root bone re-centred over world origin each frame, Z bob kept), and (2) if a literal `fbx` path below is missing, the renderer keyword-resolves it from this folder (idle/walk/run/hurt). Run `inspect_fbx.py` first to confirm the real filenames + which clips travel; rename to the literals below OR set exact paths here.

camera._note: 2:1 tiles -> dimetric2to1 (60deg from top-down) is the EXACT match (same lock as #48). modelForwardDeg calibrates the rig's facing: if the gangster faces the wrong way in-game, try 180 here (Mixamo's forward axis often flips on FBX import) OR use the runtime dirOffset in unitSpriteView. dir0 = model yaw `dirStartDeg+modelForwardDeg`, increasing clockwise in 45deg steps; the ingest's FACING_TO_DIR maps grid facing -> row.
